warnings: Section D-D is the eastern-most cut, through the car port, kitchen and laundry. Grid bubbles A B C D left to right, chain 1.60 / 2.00 / 4.00 / 5.00 / 0.40 for 11.00 m.

*** IT CARRIES ONE LEVEL FOUND ON NO OTHER SHEET: ระดับท้องจันทัน +2.55, the underside of the car-port rafter. *** With the car-port floor at +0.10 that gives 2.45 m of headroom under the rafter -- worth checking against a vehicle before it is built.
Two more clear heights are dimensioned on the car-port side, 2.85 and 2.65, alongside the usual 2.50 kitchen ceiling.

Both roof coverings appear again -- tile over the two-storey block, METAL SHEET over the car port -- and the metal-sheet roof is once more labelled 'SLOPE' with no angle. Across A-06, A-11, A-14 and A-15 that pitch is never stated.
The wet-area level ladder shows plainly here: ห้องครัว +0.40, ซักล้าง +0.38, จอดรถ +0.10.
